bridgeRouteRisk.summary: apxUSD uses Chainlink CCIP with Ethereum as the only native issuance deployment and Lock/Release pool 0x0e9cA42Bc60bE25F9A67f52173067Cc0Bb405BB5 as the canonical escrow. Base and BNB Chain are Burn/Mint bridge representations whose pool-gated mint/burn, pool-owner administration, rate-limit and peer configuration, token upgrades, pool rotation, destination caps, and pause controls are all Bridge Risk; none are counted as native Mint Authority. Current route evidence identifies the Apyx 3-of-6 Safe 0xf9862efc1704ac05e687f66e5cd8c130e5663ce2 as the common owner, with Chainlink CCIP as the external validation domain. Current numeric CCIP rate limits and live remote-peer/RMN validator settings remain an evidence gap.

routes.protocol: Apyx apxUSD (native home deployment; Chainlink CCIP lock/release lockbox)
routes.reviewNote: On-chain reads 2026-08-16 (Ethereum blocks 25770531 and 25770543): the apxUSD token has no getCCIPPool() and no LayerZero endpoint() surface (both calls revert), matching the home-chain ApxUSD.sol whose primary issuance runs through the reviewed MinterV0/AccessManager path (Mint Authority review 2026-08-16, verified). The Chainlink CCIP directory lists Ethereum pool 0x0e9cA42Bc60bE25F9A67f52173067Cc0Bb405BB5 as a Lock/Release lockbox owned by the Apyx Safe; it escrows but never mints this deployment. Native Ethereum issuance remains in Mint Authority, while the lockbox owner and escrow controls are Bridge Risk.

On-chain reads 2026-08-16 (Base block 50064463): the bridged apxUSD token's getCCIPPool() returns Chainlink CCIP BurnMintTokenPool 0x49b577E70Fd22B482aaA94c3799F41f3443C24B2; the pool's getToken() returns this token and owner() returns the Apyx 3-of-6 Safe 0xf9862efc1704ac05e687f66e5cd8c130e5663ce2. The token has no LayerZero endpoint() surface. Mint/burn is gated to the CCIP pool per the verified BridgedApyxToken source, so CCIP mints this bridge representation against the Ethereum Lock/Release lockbox; pool, token-admin, cap, pause, and pool-rotation facts are Bridge Risk rather than native Mint Authority.

On-chain reads 2026-08-16 (BSC block 116350114): the bridged apxUSD token's getCCIPPool() returns Chainlink CCIP BurnMintTokenPool 0xFD957D7E27D239da5455b82303b2F618f73a9C49; the pool's getToken() returns this token and owner() returns the Apyx 3-of-6 Safe 0xf9862efc1704ac05e687f66e5cd8c130e5663ce2. The token has no LayerZero endpoint() surface. Mint/burn is gated to the CCIP pool per the verified BridgedApyxToken source, so CCIP mints this bridge representation against the Ethereum Lock/Release lockbox; pool, token-admin, cap, pause, and pool-rotation facts are Bridge Risk rather than native Mint Authority.
